```{bash, download-metadata, eval=FALSE}
mkdir -p data
# download the sample metadata v1.4 from GitHub, make sure you download this into "sample_metadata_file" defined in .Rprofile
wget -nc -O data/IHEC_sample_metadata_harmonization.v1.4_extended.csv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IHEC/epiATLAS-metadata-harmonization/748afe0bd4167235f09c857937c5c8b62f9f49f5/openrefine/v1.4/IHEC_sample_metadata_harmonization.v1.4_extended.csv
# download experiment metadata and qc summaries from sftp
echo "get IHEC/readme/EpiATLAS_experiment_metadata.csv data/" | sftp sftp.bcgsc.ca
echo "get IHEC/readme/*_qc_summary.csv data/" | sftp sftp.bcgsc.ca
echo "get IHEC/post_processed_data/ChIP-Seq_imputed/imputation_primarymetrics.txt data/" | sftp sftp.bcgsc.ca

mkdir -p processed_data
```

```{r, find-epirr-ids}
set.seed(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L))

# Load sample metadata
metadata <- fread(sample_metadata_file)
### make a list of all epirr_ids which contain RNA-Seq, WGBS and observed or imputed ChIP-Seq data
# first subset the metadata to only include the columns epirr_id and automated_experiments*
experiment_cols <- metadata[, c(
  "epirr_id_without_version",
  grep("automated_experiments", names(metadata), value = TRUE)
)]
experiment_dt <- metadata[, ..experiment_cols]
# remove imputed WGBS imputed entries, because we do not use them
experiment_dt[
  automated_experiments_WGBS_standard == 'imputed',
  automated_experiments_WGBS_standard := ""
]
# fill empty cells in WGBS column with PBAT column
experiment_dt[
  automated_experiments_WGBS_standard == "",
  automated_experiments_WGBS_standard := automated_experiments_WGBS_PBAT
]
# create RNA-Seq column with mRNA-seq and total RNA-seq if mRNA-Seq is empty
experiment_dt[,
  `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` := `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_mRNA-Seq`
]
experiment_dt[
  `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` == "",
  `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` := `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_total-RNA-Seq`
]

# get chip-seq cols
chip_seq_cols <- grep(
  "automated_experiments_ChIP-Seq",
  names(experiment_dt),
  value = TRUE
)
# check if all chip-seq columns are filled
full_chip <- rowSums(experiment_dt[,
  lapply(.SD, function(x) x == ""),
  .SDcols = chip_seq_cols
]) ==
  0
# get epirr_ids which have all three data types
epirr_ids_to_use <- experiment_dt[
  full_chip &
    automated_experiments_WGBS_standard != "" &
    `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` != "",
  epirr_id_without_version
]
rna_seq_epirrs <- experiment_dt[
  `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq` != "",
  epirr_id_without_version
]
```

```{r, select-data-to-download}
# subset metadata again using the epirr_ids we want to use, but drag along the rna_seq_epirrs
download_metadata <- metadata[
  epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use,
  ..experiment_cols
]
# melt data table
download_metadata <- melt(
  download_metadata,
  id.vars = "epirr_id_without_version",
  variable.name = "column",
  value.name = "uuid",
  na.rm = TRUE
)
rna_only_metadata <- melt(
  metadata[
    epirr_id_without_version %in% setdiff(rna_seq_epirrs, epirr_ids_to_use),
    .(
      epirr_id_without_version,
      `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_mRNA-Seq`,
      `automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_total-RNA-Seq`
    )
  ],
  id.vars = "epirr_id_without_version",
  variable.name = "column",
  value.name = "uuid",
  na.rm = TRUE
)
download_metadata <- rbind(download_metadata, rna_only_metadata)

# split the column names to get the assay type and experiment type
download_metadata <- download_metadata[,
  c("assay_type", "experiment_type") := tstrsplit(
    column,
    "_",
    fixed = TRUE,
    keep = c(3, 4)
  )
]
# remove imputed WGBS data
download_metadata[assay_type == 'WGBS' & uuid == 'imputed', uuid := NA]
# set empty uuids to NA
download_metadata[uuid == "", uuid := NA]
# get the epirr_ids which have both RNA-Seq types and set the totalRN to NA
# both_RNA <- download_metadata[assay_type == 'RNA-Seq', if(.SD[, sum(!is.na(uuid)) > 1]).(both_RNA=TRUE), by=epirr_id_without_version]
# download_metadata[epirr_id_without_version %in% both_RNA[, epirr_id_without_version] & experiment_type == 'total-RNA-Seq', uuid := NA]
# remove empty uuids

download_metadata <- download_metadata[!is.na(uuid)]
# make sure we have 405 entries with 3 different assays and at least 8 different entries (some have more because we have some with both RNA assays)
stopifnot(download_metadata[
  epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use,
  .(
    unique_assays = uniqueN(assay_type),
    unique_experiments = uniqueN(experiment_type)
  ),
  by = epirr_id_without_version
][, all(unique_assays == 3) & all(unique_experiments >= 8)])
```


```{r, check-qc}
# read experiment metadata for observed data
experiment_metadata <- fread(
  "data/EpiATLAS_experiment_metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
) # from https://ihec.sd4h.ca/IHEC/readme/EpiATLAS_experiment_metadata.csv
experiment_metadata[, uuid := as.character(uuid)]

# get qc files https://ihec.sd4h.ca/IHEC/readme/*_qc_summary.csv
rna_qc <- fread("data/EpiATLAS_rnaseq_qc_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
rna_qc[, uuid := as.character(uuid)]
rna_qc[
  experiment_metadata,
  on = c(uuid = "uuid"),
  c(
    "experiment_type",
    "trimmed_read_length",
    "paired_end",
    "analyzed_as_stranded"
  ) := .(experiment_type, trimmed_read_length, paired_end, analyzed_as_stranded)
]
rna_qc[,
  trimmed_read_length := sapply(
    strsplit(as.character(trimmed_read_length), ";", fixed = TRUE),
    function(x) {
      stopifnot(length(unique(x)) == 1)
      as.integer(unique(x))
    }
  )
]
rna_qc[
  is.na(trimmed_read_length),
  stopifnot(uuid == "d1be4297-a068-438f-83fa-0cc62223cc56")
]
rna_qc[is.na(trimmed_read_length), trimmed_read_length := 36L]

rna_qc[,
  epirr_id_without_version := tstrsplit(epirr_id, ".", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)
]
# Mirror the logic from 02-3-rmats-event-filtering.Rmd:
#   rna_to_use = RNA-Seq UUIDs for epirrs with full epigenetic panel
#   intersect with PSI column names = UUIDs that were actually processed by rMATS
rna_to_use_01 <- download_metadata[
  assay_type == "RNA-Seq" & epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use,
  uuid
]
rmats_psi_file <- "splicing_analysis/rmats/biotype_filtered/allevent_SE.psi"
rmats_uuids <- if (file.exists(rmats_psi_file)) {
  intersect(rna_to_use_01, names(fread(rmats_psi_file, nrows = 0L, sep = "\t")))
} else {
  rna_to_use_01
}
rna_qc[, included := "all RNA-Seq"]
rna_qc[uuid %in% rmats_uuids, included := "with rMATS data"]

# RNA-Seq QC thresholds (used in both plots and flag computation)
rna_thr <- list(
  total = 50e6, # IHEC standard
  mapped = 0.7, # ENCODE ≥70%; < 0.5 previous (too lenient)
  intergenic = 0.15,
  rrna = 0.25, # ENCODE total RNA <25%; < 0.3 previous (too lenient)
  duplicates = 0.7 # ENCODE <80%; conservative
)

ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = total)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = rna_thr$total,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5e6) +
  facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = rna_thr$total, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  labs(title = "Total Reads")
ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_mapped)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = rna_thr$mapped,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = rna_thr$mapped, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  labs(title = "Fraction Mapped")
ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_intergenic)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = rna_thr$intergenic,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = rna_thr$intergenic,
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'red'
  ) +
  labs(title = "Fraction Intergenic")
ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_rrna)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = rna_thr$rrna,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = rna_thr$rrna, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  labs(title = "Fraction rRNA")
ggplot(rna_qc, aes(x = fraction_duplicates, fill = data_generating_centre)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = rna_thr$duplicates,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = rna_thr$duplicates,
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'red'
  ) +
  labs(title = "Fraction Duplicated Reads")
rna_qc[, rna_potentially_problematic := FALSE]
rna_qc[
  total < rna_thr$total |
    fraction_mapped < rna_thr$mapped |
    fraction_intergenic > rna_thr$intergenic |
    fraction_rrna > rna_thr$rrna |
    fraction_duplicates > rna_thr$duplicates,
  rna_potentially_problematic := TRUE
]
rna_qc_stats <- c(
  "epirr_id_without_version",
  "uuid",
  "rna_potentially_problematic",
  "total",
  "fraction_mapped",
  "fraction_intergenic",
  "fraction_rrna",
  "fraction_duplicates"
)

chip_qc <- fread(
  "data/EpiATLAS_chipseq_qc_summary.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)
chip_qc[, uuid := as.character(uuid)]
chip_qc_stats <- names(chip_qc)[
  !names(chip_qc) %in%
    c("uuid", "data_generating_centre", "epirr_id", "antibody")
]
chip_qc[, included := "EpiATLAS"]
chip_qc[
  uuid %in% download_metadata[assay_type == "ChIP-Seq", uuid],
  included := "this_project"
]

# ChIP-Seq QC thresholds (used in both plots and flag computation)
chip_thr <- list(
  mapped_pct = 80, # ENCODE >80%; < 60 previous (too lenient)
  dupes_pct = 0.80, # ENCODE <80%; stored as fraction (0-1), not percent
  nrf = 0.5, # ENCODE minimum (compliant: 0.8, ideal: 0.9)
  pbc1 = 0.5, # ENCODE minimum (compliant: 0.8)
  pbc2 = 1, # ENCODE minimum (compliant: 3)
  frip = 0.02, # IHEC minimum (broad marks: H3K27me3, H3K9me3, H3K36me3)
  frip_narrow = 0.05, # Landt et al. 2012 (narrow marks: H3K27ac, H3K4me3, H3K4me1)
  frip_overlap = 0.02 # IHEC minimum
)
narrow_marks <- c("H3K27ac", "H3K4me3", "H3K4me1")

ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `flagstat_qc:mapped_pct`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = chip_thr$mapped_pct,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(antibody ~ included) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = chip_thr$mapped_pct,
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'red'
  ) +
  labs(title = "Mapped Reads %")
ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `dup_qc:dupes_pct`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = chip_thr$dupes_pct,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  facet_grid(antibody ~ included) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = chip_thr$dupes_pct,
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'red'
  ) +
  labs(title = "Duplicate Read Fraction")
ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `pbc_qc:NRF`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = chip_thr$nrf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  facet_grid(antibody ~ included) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = chip_thr$nrf, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  labs(title = "Non-Redundant Fraction (NRF)")
ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `pbc_qc:PBC1`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = chip_thr$pbc1,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  facet_grid(antibody ~ included) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = chip_thr$pbc1, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  labs(title = "PCR Bottlenecking Coefficient 1 (PBC1)")
ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `pbc_qc:PBC2`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = chip_thr$pbc2,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 50)) +
  facet_grid(antibody ~ included) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = chip_thr$pbc2, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  labs(title = "PCR Bottlenecking Coefficient 2 (PBC2)")
ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `frip_macs2_qc:rep1.FRiP`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = chip_thr$frip,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  facet_grid(antibody ~ included) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = chip_thr$frip, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  labs(title = "Fraction of Reads in Peaks (FRiP)")
ggplot(chip_qc, aes(x = `overlap_frip_qc:rep1-pr.FRiP`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = chip_thr$frip_overlap,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +
  facet_grid(antibody ~ included) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = chip_thr$frip_overlap,
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'red'
  ) +
  labs(title = "Fraction of Reads in Peaks across Replicates (FRiP)")
chip_qc[, potentially_problematic := FALSE]
chip_qc_stats <- c("potentially_problematic", chip_qc_stats)
# removed : | `flagstat_qc:paired_properly_pct` < 90
# FRiP threshold depends on mark type: narrow marks (H3K27ac, H3K4me3, H3K4me1) use 0.05; broad marks use 0.02
chip_qc[, frip_threshold := chip_thr$frip]
chip_qc[antibody %in% narrow_marks, frip_threshold := chip_thr$frip_narrow]
chip_qc[
  `flagstat_qc:mapped_pct` < chip_thr$mapped_pct |
    `dup_qc:dupes_pct` > chip_thr$dupes_pct |
    `pbc_qc:NRF` < chip_thr$nrf |
    `pbc_qc:PBC1` < chip_thr$pbc1 |
    `pbc_qc:PBC2` < chip_thr$pbc2 |
    `frip_macs2_qc:rep1.FRiP` < frip_threshold |
    `overlap_frip_qc:rep1-pr.FRiP` < chip_thr$frip_overlap,
  potentially_problematic := TRUE
]
chip_qc[,
  epirr_id_without_version := tstrsplit(epirr_id, ".", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)
]
chip_qc_long <- melt(
  chip_qc,
  id.vars = c(
    "epirr_id_without_version",
    "potentially_problematic",
    "included",
    "antibody"
  ),
  measure.vars = chip_qc_stats
)
chip_qc_wide <- dcast(
  chip_qc_long,
  epirr_id_without_version + included ~ antibody + variable
)

wgbs_qc <- fread("data/EpiATLAS_wgbs_qc_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
wgbs_qc[, uuid := as.character(uuid)]
wgbs_qc[, included := "EpiATLAS"]
wgbs_qc[
  uuid %in% download_metadata[assay_type == "WGBS", uuid],
  included := "this_project"
]
wgbs_qc[
  experiment_metadata,
  on = c(uuid = "uuid"),
  c("experiment_type") := .(experiment_type)
]

# WGBS QC thresholds (used in both plots and flag computation)
wgbs_thr <- list(
  cpg_coverage = 10, # IHEC/ENCODE ≥10×; aligns with meth10 downstream; < 3 previous (too lenient)
  bs_conversion = 0.97, # IHEC ≥97%; < 0.95 previous (ENCODE minimum only)
  gc_corr = 0.7 # applied as abs(GC_cov_Correlation) > gc_corr; no standard
)

ggplot(wgbs_qc, aes(x = `Mean_CpG_Coverage`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = wgbs_thr$cpg_coverage,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = wgbs_thr$cpg_coverage,
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'red'
  ) +
  labs(title = "Mean CpG Coverage")
ggplot(wgbs_qc, aes(x = `BS_conversion_Rate`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = wgbs_thr$bs_conversion,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.005) +
  facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = wgbs_thr$bs_conversion,
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'red'
  ) +
  labs(title = "Bisulfite Conversion Rate")
ggplot(wgbs_qc, aes(x = `GC_cov_Correlation`)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = -wgbs_thr$gc_corr,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = wgbs_thr$gc_corr,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    alpha = 0.1,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05) +
  facet_grid(experiment_type ~ included) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-wgbs_thr$gc_corr, wgbs_thr$gc_corr),
    linetype = 'dashed',
    color = 'red'
  ) +
  labs(title = "GC Coverage Correlation")
wgbs_qc[, wgbs_potentially_problematic := FALSE]
wgbs_qc[
  `Mean_CpG_Coverage` < wgbs_thr$cpg_coverage |
    `BS_conversion_Rate` < wgbs_thr$bs_conversion |
    `GC_cov_Correlation` < -wgbs_thr$gc_corr |
    `GC_cov_Correlation` > wgbs_thr$gc_corr,
  wgbs_potentially_problematic := TRUE
]
wgbs_qc[,
  epirr_id_without_version := tstrsplit(epirr_id, ".", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)
]
wgbs_qc_stats <- c(
  "epirr_id_without_version",
  "wgbs_potentially_problematic",
  "Mean_CpG_Coverage",
  "BS_conversion_Rate",
  "GC_cov_Correlation"
)

# now merge all three qc tables based on epirr_id_without_version but only the ones where included == "this_project"
merged_qc <-
  merge(
    merge(
      chip_qc_wide[included == "this_project", -"included"],
      rna_qc[included == "this_project", ..rna_qc_stats],
      by = "epirr_id_without_version",
      all = TRUE
    ),
    wgbs_qc[included == "this_project", ..wgbs_qc_stats],
    by = "epirr_id_without_version",
    all = TRUE
  )

# Compute flag count per sample (sum of all potentially_problematic columns)
flag_cols <- names(merged_qc)[grepl(
  "potentially_problematic",
  names(merged_qc)
)]
merged_qc[, qc_flag_count := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = flag_cols]

fwrite(merged_qc, "processed_data/qc_summary.csv")

# Export covariate file for downstream models (Policy A: retain all 405 samples)
# UUID-keyed so it joins correctly onto aggregated_dt (keyed by uuid); WGBS/ChIP flags
# are epirr-level and duplicated per UUID row, which is intentional for epirrs with
# both mRNA-Seq and total-RNA-Seq.
qc_flag_covariates <- merged_qc[, .(
  epirr_id_without_version,
  uuid,
  qc_flag_count,
  rna_potentially_problematic,
  wgbs_potentially_problematic
)]
fwrite(qc_flag_covariates, "processed_data/qc_flag_covariates.csv")

# Per-ontology and per-flag reporting
dir.create("qc", showWarnings = FALSE)
lines <- c()

# Flag count distribution
lines <- c(lines, "=== QC Flag Count Distribution (all 405 samples) ===", "")
flag_dist <- merged_qc[, .N, by = qc_flag_count][order(qc_flag_count)]
lines <- c(lines, "Flag count distribution:")
for (i in 1:nrow(flag_dist)) {
  lines <- c(
    lines,
    sprintf(
      "  %d flags: %d samples",
      flag_dist[i, qc_flag_count],
      flag_dist[i, N]
    )
  )
}

# Per-ontology breakdown
lines <- c(lines, "", "=== Per-Ontology Flag Distribution ===", "")
onto_flags <- merged_qc[
  metadata[, .(
    epirr_id_without_version,
    harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1
  )],
  on = "epirr_id_without_version"
][,
  .(
    n_samples = .N,
    mean_flags = mean(qc_flag_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_flagged = sum(qc_flag_count > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1
][order(-n_flagged)]

for (i in 1:nrow(onto_flags)) {
  row <- onto_flags[i]
  lines <- c(
    lines,
    sprintf(
      "  %s: %d/%d samples flagged, mean flags %.2f",
      row$harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1,
      row$n_flagged,
      row$n_samples,
      row$mean_flags
    )
  )
}

# Per-flag counts (RNA, WGBS, ChIP marks)
lines <- c(lines, "", "=== Per-Flag Counts ===", "")
flag_cols <- names(merged_qc)[grepl(
  "potentially_problematic",
  names(merged_qc)
)]
for (col in flag_cols) {
  mark <- gsub("_potentially_problematic", "", col)
  n_flagged <- sum(merged_qc[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("  %s: %d samples", mark, n_flagged))
}

writeLines(lines, "qc/qc_flag_summary.txt")

download_metadata[
  epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use,
  table(
    experiment_type,
    uuid %in%
      c(
        rna_qc[rna_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid],
        chip_qc[potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid],
        wgbs_qc[wgbs_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid]
      )
  )
]
download_metadata[
  epirr_id_without_version %in%
    epirr_ids_to_use &
    uuid %in%
      c(
        rna_qc[rna_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid],
        chip_qc[potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid],
        wgbs_qc[wgbs_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid]
      ),
  uniqueN(epirr_id_without_version)
]
potentially_remove_epirr <- download_metadata[
  uuid %in%
    c(
      rna_qc[rna_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid],
      chip_qc[potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid],
      wgbs_qc[wgbs_potentially_problematic == TRUE, uuid]
    ),
  unique(epirr_id_without_version)
]
metadata[
  epirr_id_without_version %in% epirr_ids_to_use,
  table(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1, epiATLAS_status)
]
metadata[
  epirr_id_without_version %in%
    epirr_ids_to_use &
    !epirr_id_without_version %in% potentially_remove_epirr,
  table(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1, epiATLAS_status)
]
```


```{r, make-ftp-list}
# add epirr_id for the specific version and software version
download_metadata[
  experiment_metadata,
  on = .NATURAL,
  c("epirr_id", "software_version") := .(epirr_id, software_version)
]

# read experiment metadata for observed +imputed data
imputed_experiment_metadata <- fread(
  "data/EpiATLAS_imputed_experiment_metadata.csv"
) # from https://ihec.sd4h.ca/IHEC/readme/EpiATLAS_imputed_experiment_metadata.csv
# add epirr_id for the specific version and data_path
imputed_experiment_metadata[,
  epirr_id_without_version := tstrsplit(epirr_id, ".", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1)
]
imputed_experiment_metadata[, uuid := 'imputed']
imputed_experiment_metadata[, experiment_type := mark]
download_metadata[
  imputed_experiment_metadata,
  on = c('epirr_id_without_version', 'uuid', 'experiment_type'),
  c("epirr_id", "data_file_path") := .(i.epirr_id, data_file_path)
]

# create the file paths from filenames
download_metadata[
  assay_type == 'ChIP-Seq',
  filename := paste(
    "ihec.chipseq.ihec-chipseq-containerv1.1.4",
    epirr_id,
    uuid,
    "pval.signal.bigwig",
    sep = '.'
  )
]
download_metadata[
  assay_type == 'RNA-Seq',
  filename := paste(
    "ihec.rna-seq.ihec-grapenf-containerv1.1.0",
    epirr_id,
    uuid,
    "isoforms.results",
    sep = '.'
  )
]
download_metadata[,
  file_path := file.path(
    'IHEC/base_data',
    epirr_id_without_version,
    experiment_type,
    filename
  )
]
# different path for imputed ChIP-Seq data
download_metadata[
  uuid == 'imputed',
  file_path := sub(
    'incoming',
    "IHEC/post_processed_data",
    data_file_path,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
]
# write the downloaded files to file for later
fwrite(download_metadata, "processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")
# we download WGBS data using the post processed WGBS matrices
wgbs_matrices <- paste0(
  "IHEC/post_processed_data/WGBS_matrices/meth10/chr",
  seq.int(22),
  ".meth10.csv.gz"
)
final_paths <- c(
  download_metadata[assay_type != 'WGBS', file_path],
  wgbs_matrices
)
writeLines(final_paths, "processed_data/ftp_paths.txt")
# now you can download the files in ftp_paths.txt
```

    assay_type == 'RNA-Seq',

  ])),

    file.path(chip_data_dir, basename(file_path))
  ])),
  "some WGBS matrices are not downloaded yet" = all(file.exists(file.path(
    wgbs_matrices_data_dir,
    basename(wgbs_matrices)
  )))
)
